Calibration RED (ECE 0.0575>0.05, streak 0/3); >=80 confidence tail overconfident (52.2% actual vs 86.4% claimed). Board NOT launch-ready; PASS is correct. Refresh roster/injury feed + recalibrate tail before promotion. Dual-Oracle Decisions API reported live; reserved for Stage-3/5, no paid calls.
